relocation_line: I will relocate to Wagga Wagga or Forbes for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi Martinus team,

I'm Marc Masarate, and a graduate engineer role is what I'm after. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). You're taking on civil graduates for Inland Rail near Forbes, so I'm applying.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on two building sites in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge and then as field engineer. I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day and prepared progress reports. In the diploma I designed roads, earthworks and drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D.

I'm able to move to Wagga Wagga or Forbes and start two weeks after an offer. I hold a White Card and have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to have a chat whenever you like.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
